claims.text: Thermomechanical treatment of MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials will refine their microstructure.
Microstructural refinement produced by thermomechanical treatment will increase the strength of MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials.
Microstructural refinement produced by thermomechanical treatment will increase the toughness of MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials.
Thermomechanical treatment will retain a large magnetocaloric effect in MnNiSi-based magnetic-refrigeration materials.
The proposed mechanical improvement and retained magnetocaloric effect will hold over the temperature and magnetic-field ranges used for magnetic refrigeration.
The untreated baseline has a known magnetocaloric effect but may have poor mechanical performance.
